intro.label: Skills
intro.title: Configuration, and the management that keeps it working.
intro.lede: Two halves of the same job. The technical work keeps a server stable, and the management work keeps it stable after I've left.

groups.title: Plugin configuration
groups.summary: Making twenty plugins behave like one system instead of twenty.
items: LuckPerms tracks, contexts and per server overrides
Economy balancing with matched income and sinks
ItemsAdder and MythicMobs as one content pipeline
Config conflict debugging across competing plugins

groups.title: Servers and performance
groups.summary: Getting the platform right before a single plugin goes near it.
items: Paper and Purpur tuning for real tick time gains
Shared player data and cross server chat
Spark and timings reports read properly
Pterodactyl nodes, backups and staged migrations

groups.title: Discord configuration
groups.summary: Structure and automation for communities that outgrew one channel.
items: Role hierarchies that stay readable past thirty roles
Bot setup wired to a written rule set
Webhook relays for chat and punishments
Rank sync between Minecraft and Discord

groups.title: Staff and management
groups.summary: Building teams that make good calls with nobody watching.
items: Written application scoring so hiring is repeatable
Two week onboarding with shadowing and sign off
Shift rotas and handover notes across timezones
Escalation ladders with a named owner per decision
Moderation policy and appeal routes that stay fair
One to ones and honest feedback before people quit

toolbox.label: Toolbox
toolbox.title: What I reach for.
toolbox.lede: Not a full list, just the things I use without thinking about it.
